china-1924-5:p0848_2.rationale: Salt Revenue Account balances, net collections and interest credited by the Group Banks, 1921-23. This is a fiscal account of salt revenue.

china-1924-5:p0852_1.rationale: Salt revenue received and outstanding by district inspectorate, 1919-21.

china-1924-5:p0853_1.rationale: Expenses incurred by each salt district inspectorate, 1919-21, as part of salt revenue administration.

china-1924-5:p0853_2.rationale: Transfers of salt revenue to the group banks, 1919-21. The district labels are blank in the transcription, but the totals match the transfers column of the preceding salt table.
